rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error (nested collection interface); f8959 (2025) p.1 line1 totals W-2 box5 across filers/employers. W-2 is explicitly nested under person in the shared catalog. A root sum_over(w2) in the second looks for an undeclared root $w2 roster instead of the confirmed per-person rosters; it does not express that total. On stage13.excess_ss_you, the project produces the required numeric sum and the second is unknown for missing $w2. Proof: .transcription/f8959-flat-w2-witness.json. The project nests the sum through person.medicare5. This is not a source disagreement about the tax rate.

Ruling: representation; f8959 (2025) p.1 lines5,9,15 print identical filing-status thresholds ($250000 joint, $125000 separate, $200000 other). Project line5 is exactly parameter medicare.threshold; copying that printed line and repeating the same status-keyed parameter return the same amount. No threshold, filing-status choice or unsupported-source screen changes.
